● Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically — Claude checks each tool call for risky actions
  and prompt injection before executing. Actions Claude identifies as safe are executed, while actions Claude
  identifies as risky are blocked and Claude may try a different approach. Ideal for long-running tasks.
  Sessions are slightly more expensive. Claude can make mistakes that allow harmful commands to run, it's
  recommended to only use in isolated environments. Shift+Tab to change mode.

❯ Run the probe ccm:probe

  We're changing auto mode to no longer charge for classifier requests in Claude Code.

  However, this session isn't eligible because your requests go through 127.0.0.1:45159, which isn't compatible with
  this update.

  Auto mode works for now, and its classifier requests are billed as before. An upcoming release removes this
  fallback. In sessions like this one, each checked action will then be asked about or denied.

  To fix it and access the new version of auto mode, ask your gateway to implement:
  https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing
